content.what_it_is: MATLAB script that samples the four sides of one rectangular longitude/latitude box. It forms x/y coordinate vectors (L8-L14), appends east/west/south/north points with side ids 1-4 (L17-L51), plots the station path and a count diagnostic (L53-L61), then writes coordinate pairs and side ids to station_NA.txt (L66-L68).
entities: sta station table @L21-L23 and subsequent side assignments
unresolved: The inline comment says `60 times` at L3, but the expression is 6/3600 degree (six arcseconds), a tenfold copy/comment mismatch that can mislead grid-spacing edits.

Location labels conflict across the file: L7 says Wilmington NC, while the diagnostic filename is `NestRI_NA.jpg` at L61 and the station output is `station_NA.txt` at L66. The source does not resolve which case identity is intended.

All four side loops include both endpoints (L19-L51), so corners are duplicated under adjacent side identifiers while the count formula at L53 explicitly includes those duplicates; downstream corner convention is not stated here.
`icount_last` is assigned at L63 but never read. The plot path assumes a `plots` directory, and fopen is unchecked before fprintf at L66-L68.
